verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators that talk to hosts over USB HID, NFC and BLE using the WebAuthn/FIDO standards. They expose no web service API, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Feitian shipping a web API that such a spec could describe; the probe's 404s on spec paths do not make the axis applicable.
